title: Treason
text: Giving aid and comfort while owing allegiance to the state.

title: Resisting or obstructing an executive officer
text: Attempting by threats or violence to deter or prevent an executive officer from performing a lawful duty.

title: Resisting, obstructing, or delaying an officer
text: Willfully resisting, delaying, or obstructing an officer or EMT from performing duties.

title: Murder
text: Unlawful killing of a human being or fetus with malice aforethought.

title: Manslaughter
text: Killing a human being without malice aforethought.

title: Kidnapping
text: Moving another person without consent by force or fear.

title: Robbery
text: Taking personal property from another by force or fear.

title: Carjacking
text: Taking a motor vehicle in another's possession by force or fear.

title: False imprisonment
text: Restraining, confining, or detaining a person against their will.

title: Assault
text: Attempt to commit a violent injury with present ability.

title: Battery
text: Willful use of force or violence upon another person.

title: Battery on a significant other
text: Battery on an intimate partner without visible marks.

title: Assault with deadly weapon (not firearm)
text: Assault with a deadly weapon other than a firearm, or force likely to produce great bodily injury.

title: Assault with a firearm
text: Using a firearm to assault another person.

title: Shooting at inhabited dwelling or occupied vehicle
text: Willfully discharging a firearm at an inhabited dwelling, occupied building, occupied vehicle, or occupied aircraft.

title: Rape
text: Sexual intercourse without consent by force, fear, or against will.

title: Statutory rape
text: Sexual intercourse with a person under 18.

title: Contributing to delinquency of a minor
text: Act or omission encouraging a minor to become dependent, delinquent, or habitual truant.

title: Cruelty to a child
text: Causing or permitting unjustifiable pain or placing a child in a dangerous situation.

title: Spousal abuse
text: Abuse causing visible injury against spouse/cohabitant/former partner or parent of shared child.

title: Sodomy
text: Penile penetration of another's anus, regardless of how slight, without consent.

title: Oral copulation
text: Any contact between mouth and another's sexual organ or anus.

title: Lewd acts on a child
text: Willfully touching a child or coercing contact with intent to arouse sexual desires; child under 14.

title: Indecent exposure
text: Willfully exposing genitals in presence of others likely to be offended.

title: Elder abuse
text: Physical, financial, or other abuse causing pain or suffering to a person age 65 or older.

title: Disturbing the peace
text: Unlawful fighting, unreasonable loud noise, or offensive words likely to provoke immediate violence.

title: Brandishing a weapon or firearm
text: Drawing or exhibiting a deadly weapon in a rude, angry, or threatening manner.

title: Criminal threats
text: Willful threat to kill or seriously injure, verbally/written/electronically, causing reasonable sustained fear.

title: Arson
text: Willfully and maliciously setting fire to, burning, or causing burning of structure, land, or property.

title: Burglary
text: Entering a structure or locked vehicle with intent to commit theft or felony.

title: Possession of burglary tools
text: Possession of burglary tools with intent to break or enter to commit theft.

title: Forgery
text: Knowingly signing another's name, falsifying legal documents, or presenting false financial/property documents.

title: Possessing/receiving forged items
text: Knowingly possessing or receiving forged items.

title: Theft
text: Steal, take, carry, lead, or drive away personal property of another.

title: Grand theft
text: Stealing property valued over the threshold amount.

title: Possession of stolen property
text: Knowingly buying, selling, or receiving stolen property.

title: Destruction of phone/electric/cable line
text: Maliciously destroying or taking down communication/electrical lines.

title: Vandalism
text: Maliciously defacing, damaging, or destroying property not your own.

title: Trespassing
text: Entering/occupying property without permission and refusing to leave when asked.

title: Stalking
text: Willfully, maliciously, and repeatedly following or harassing another person.

title: Lewd conduct
text: Engaging in or soliciting lewd conduct in public or exposed to public view.

title: Prostitution
text: Engaging in sexual acts in exchange for money, goods, or services.

title: Public intoxication
text: Intoxication to point of inability to care for safety or obstructing public ways.

title: Peeping
text: Loitering/prowling on private property and peeking into inhabited structure without lawful business.

title: Annoying telephone calls
text: Making repeated calls, threats, or obscene communications by phone/electronic device.

title: Attempt
text: Attempting to commit a crime.

title: Probation violation/revocation
text: Violating terms and conditions of probation.

title: Parole violation
text: Illegal act or offense breaching parole conditions.

title: Possession of controlled substance
text: Possessing a controlled substance without valid prescription.

title: Possession of controlled substance for sale
text: Possessing controlled substance without prescription with intent to sell.

title: Possession of rock cocaine for sale
text: Possessing rock cocaine with intent to sell.

title: Transporting/selling controlled substance
text: Transporting controlled substance with intent to sell.

title: Possession of marijuana
text: Unlawful possession of marijuana.

title: Possession of paraphernalia
text: Knowingly possessing drug paraphernalia such as pipes, needles, burnt spoons.

title: Possession of methamphetamine
text: Knowingly and willfully possessing methamphetamine.

title: Possession of methamphetamine for sale
text: Knowingly and willfully possessing methamphetamine with intent to sell.

title: Under the influence of controlled substance
text: Willfully using or being under the influence of a controlled substance or narcotic.

title: Minor in possession of alcohol
text: Person under 21 possessing alcohol in public place except certain lawful exceptions.
